command-line.$description: A one-line prompt: `:` for commands, `/` for search. It sits in the status bar or at the foot of the palette. See docs/decisions/0017-command-line.md.

count-gap.$description: Least space between the typed text and the count, so a long line never runs into it.

prompt.$description: The `:` or `/` before the typed text.

count.$description: Position and number of suggestions, such as 1/37, as fzf shows them.

cursor.$description: Block cursor, the same inverted cell as the editor's normal mode cursor.
